sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 2). You can tell when someone's lying, scared, or hiding something. It's in the shoulders.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 2). Find the interest behind the position. They're not fighting about the thing — they're fighting about respect.

📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
📖 Your old life taught you things. 3 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ryan Anderson. Interpreter. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Daughter's Drawing, Contract Quill, Brass Locket, Dispatcher's headset, Home key. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people.
